missingValueEncoding: JSON null / IEEE NaN. HistGradientBoosting native missing routing; no imputed fill at inference.

historyBreaks.backwardJump: if rawDelta < -0.3 km and not a terminus wrap (rawDelta < -0.5 and wrapPositive(rawDelta,L) < 0.8 km), break chain

features.name: currentSpeed
features.formula: reported AVL speed of the current unique observation

features.name: horizonSeconds
features.forbiddenLiveMeaning: MUST NOT be time until the next BT observation. That would leak the future.
features.trainingVsRuntimeWarning: Offline 7A trained on observed pair intervals (median ~10 s, range 1-56 s). Live queries can request arbitrary dataAge. Arbitrary-age performance is NOT validated.

features.name: prevSpeed1
features.formula: reported speed of the immediately previous usable unique same-trip observation
features.missing: NaN if no previous unique obs or history link broken
features.resetBreaks: see historyBreaks; after a break, prevSpeed2/3 are also missing

features.name: prevSpeed2
features.formula: speed of unique obs two steps back, only if both links (current-2→current-1 and current-1→current) are usable
features.missing: NaN if chain shorter than 2 usable links

features.name: prevSpeed3
features.formula: speed of unique obs three steps back, only if all three links are usable
features.missing: NaN if chain shorter than 3 usable links

features.name: dtPrev1
features.formula: (current.version - prev1.version) / 1000 even if the link is later rejected; if rejected, prevSpeed1 is NaN and the chain stops. If no previous obs, NaN.
features.missing: NaN if no previous unique obs exists

features.name: dtPrev2
features.formula: (prev1.version - prev2.version) / 1000 under the same chain rules
features.missing: NaN if chain does not reach prev2

features.name: dtPrev3
features.formula: (prev2.version - prev3.version) / 1000 under the same chain rules
features.missing: NaN if chain does not reach prev3

features.name: speedDelta2
features.missing: NaN if prevSpeed1 or prevSpeed2 is missing

features.name: recentSpeedSlope
features.observations: Current unique obs plus up to 3 previous unique same-trip obs, walking backward while usableHistoryLink succeeds. If the first (current-1) link fails, slope is missing. If a later link fails after at least one good previous point, slope is computed on the prefix that succeeded.
features.timeCoordinate: t_current = 0. Each previous obs has t = -sum of usable dts along the chain (negative elapsed historical time).
features.ols: Ordinary least squares slope of speed vs t: slope = sum((t_i - mean_t) * (v_i - mean_v)) / sum((t_i - mean_t)^2). If denominator <= 1e-9 or fewer than 2 points, missing.
features.missing: NaN if <2 points (typically no usable previous obs)

features.name: previousRealizedRouteSpeed
features.twoObservations: previous usable unique obs (hist[0] = current-1) and current
features.signedDistance: dKm = wrapToSigned(current.routeProgressKm - prev1.routeProgressKm, L) where wrapToSigned maps to (-L/2, L/2]. Multiply by 1000 for metres.
features.dt: (current.version - prev1.version) / 1000, requiring dt > 0 and a usable link
features.wrap: loop wrap that is a small forward step across the terminus is allowed by usableHistoryLink
features.backwardJumpsSnapFlips: unusable links yield NaN; do not use wrap-positive full-lap distance
features.tripChanges: history is per busId|gtfsTripId; a new trip has no previous same-trip obs
features.missing: NaN if prevSpeed1 missing or dtPrev1 missing/<=0

features.name: distanceToNextScheduledStopMeters
features.semantics: Stops ordered by GTFS-mapped stopProgressKm. Next stop is the first with stopProgressKm > currentProgressKm + 0.005 km (5 m pass tolerance). On the CAS loop, after the last stop, wraps to the first stop: distance = (L - current + firstStopProgress) * 1000.
features.missing: NaN only if GTFS trip has no stop candidates (should not happen for CAS)

features.name: distanceFromPreviousScheduledStopMeters
features.formula: Previous stop = last GTFS stop with stopProgressKm < currentProgressKm - 0.005 km. distance = (current - prevStopProgress) * 1000. If none (near start of shape), wrap to the last stop: (current + L - lastStopProgress) * 1000.
features.missing: NaN only if trip has no stops
